coastal.title: Are the raspberries in my fridge OK to eat? What to know about chemical levels on Driscoll's berries
coastal.description: You may be having second thoughts about eating the berries in your fridge after CBC News spoke with a whistleblower who made a startling claim about the amount of chemicals on fruit that a U.S. company allegedly shipped to Canada.

kamloops.title: Woven baskets gifted to Okanagan elder, replacing those lost to wildfire
kamloops.description: A B.C. woman who read an Okanagan Indian Band elder's story of losing treasured items in the Bradley Creek wildfire gifted him four woven baskets, believed to be of Syilx origin, from her home.

kamloops.title: 'It's a disgrace': Naramata residents demand answers after termination of fire chief
kamloops.description: Naramata, B.C., residents have launched a petition calling on the Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen to change the culture and improve the dynamics with local fire services, following the abrupt firing of fire chief Dennis Smith in July.

prince-george.title: Boat collision at Woodfibre LNG site near Squamish was due to safety gaps, TSB finds
prince-george.description: Canada's Transportation Safety Board has found a series of gaps leading to a crash between a tugboat and a workboat in 2024, sinking one of the vessels in the waters near Squamish, B.C.
